info.note: declines every turn; the floor every other row is read against

meta.history: every earlier turn of the conversation, in order

answerable.denominator: every turn labelled answerable (108); hold, wrong, unverifiable and execution_error count against

not_scored.note: statement ('hold' label, act record), correction and why turns are scored by the gate against recorded state and evidence rows; a reply text cannot show them

questions.denominator: every question (156); no unparsed bucket: a reply text cannot show whether a setup statement was recorded

problems.denominator: every problem (114); correct when every question is correct, wrong when any question is wrong

cost.memory_measure: macOS phys_footprint of the answerer's process after each turn (includes GPU buffers); peak is the process's lifetime maximum
